Evidence: Wreath-laying ceremony, public scolding, sentinel reprimand
#Aletheia #Arlington 🌐

Using sacred military memorials as mere theatrical backdrops while treating solemn protocols with casual disregard.
The plane error confuses institutional performance (WHO) with actual adherence to solemn military discipline (WHAT).

Social Physics Analysis:
Hegseth runs a smart selfish maneuver, projecting patriotism through formal ceremonies while extracting personal social ease over sacred institutional norms.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Sacred memorials demand absolute solemnity regardless of political rank.

The Unavoidable Lie: Power exempts leaders from basic institutional decorum.

Performative patriotism collapses the moment private convenience supersedes public duty at the nation's most hallowed ground.

It's heartbreaking to see sacred spaces meant for quiet remembrance treated with such thoughtless casualness. The Unknown Soldier deserves our utmost silence and reverence.

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier ===

[Source 1 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/ck5y132yq1ymo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier

Following a wreath-laying ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at by a US Army sentinel to be quiet.

[Source 2 — www.aljazeera.com (Bias: Center / State-Funded International)] (URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/hegseth-entourage-reprimanded-by-guard-at-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier?traffic_source=rss):
Hegseth entourage reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier

Guard at memorial site can be heard yelling at group to 'maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times'.

[Source 3 — www.cbc.ca (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/hegseth-veterans-day-arlington-tomb-laughter-guard-yells-9.7418661?cmp=rss):
Hegseth, wife and aides spark scolding from guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier

A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery issued a verbal reprimand to a group of advisers and staffers with U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth following a Veterans Day ceremony.
